authority: Navigation map of PART 0's ownership procedure; not a replacement parser or a conformance profile.

phases.title: O1 Strip prefixes
phases.constraint: Prefixes are consumed outward-in. An opaque body takes its line before any other step, and comments are classified before an owner is selected.

phases.title: O2 Select the owner
phases.constraint: The innermost frame whose prefix the line supplied owns it. A line below a content column did not supply that prefix.

phases.title: O3 Fold into the open paragraph
phases.constraint: A noninterrupting line folds only into the deepest leaf’s open paragraph with its continuation claim. Recognition uses the selected owner’s coordinates and scope. A fold closes nothing.

phases.title: O4 Classify in the owner
phases.constraint: Frames deeper than the owner close. An indentation frame reads an opener at or past its content column on its authored base; the document and a quote need the exact column.

phases.title: T Apply the transition
phases.constraint: Container survival and paragraph openness are separate facts, set by the boundary the line formed.

phases.title: X1 to X3 Named exceptions
phases.constraint: Comment retention keeps a container with no paragraph open. The quote band and the opaque marker-line quote fold lines the host would otherwise read.

evidence.projection: Reviewed HTML bytes; these fixtures do not prove invisible AST ownership or arbitrary-depth equivalence.
